default.notes: A visa is required — apply online through the official Malawi eVisa portal (evisa.gov.mw) before travel; visas are typically issued for 30 days and can be extended in-country.

groups.notes: SADC citizens enter Malawi visa-free — normally admitted for up to 30 days at a time, extendable at immigration offices.

Visa-free under Malawi's 2024 waiver reform, which scrapped visas for some 79 countries — visitors are normally admitted for 30 days, extendable in-country; the list is updated periodically, so confirm eligibility before travel.

MW.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Malawian citizens.
